ToSendMessageToVoiceAgent: to send a message back to the voice agent
ToSendMessageToVoiceAgentDispatcher: to send instructions to the voice agent dispatcher
ToGetLatestVoiceAgentDispatcherTurn: to get the latest voice agent dispatcher turn
ToGetBoundSessionRecentTurns: to get recent turns from the session bound to the voice agent
ToGetBoundSessionTurnDetail: to get a turn from the session bound to the voice agent
ToGetBoundSessionMessageMarkdown: to get a message from the session bound to the voice agent

ActionDescriptions.ToGetBoundSessionMessageMarkdown:
to get a message from the session bound to the voice agent
messageKey - selected message identifier from bound turn detail. Returns bounded markdown from the trusted target session; no session key or file path is accepted.
ActionDescriptions.ToGetBoundSessionRecentTurns:
to get recent turns from the session bound to the voice agent
maxTurns - number of recent turn summaries to read, from 1 through 10. Resolves the target only from the current Voice Agent's trusted server binding.
ActionDescriptions.ToGetBoundSessionTurnDetail:
to get a turn from the session bound to the voice agent
turnId - selected turn identifier from bound recent turns. maxRows - bounded detail row count, from 1 through 200. The target session cannot be supplied or changed.
ActionDescriptions.ToGetLatestVoiceAgentDispatcherTurn:
to get the latest voice agent dispatcher turn
Returns the most recent turn summary from the bound dispatcher. Use once for missing detail, never for polling.
ActionDescriptions.ToSendMessageToVoiceAgent: instruction - complete useful answer material to queue to the bound Voice Agent. Adds the exact dispatcher timeline label and returns immediately using the established Level 2 end-cycle pattern.
ActionDescriptions.ToSendMessageToVoiceAgentDispatcher:
to send instructions to the voice agent dispatcher
instruction - self-contained work or follow-up to queue through the current Voice Agent's server-owned dispatch authority. Queues without waiting and returns immediately using the established Level 2 end-cycle pattern.
